steps.question: 近30天各渠道ROI：已支付销售额除以投放花费，两表各自按渠道汇总后计算，按ROI降序
steps.sql: SELECT m.channel AS 渠道, ROUND(COALESCE(o.paid_sales, 0) / NULLIF(m.spend, 0), 2) AS ROI FROM (SELECT channel, ROUND(SUM(spend), 2) AS spend FROM marketing_spend WHERE spend_date BETWEEN '2026-01-30' AND '2026-02-28' GROUP BY channel) AS m LEFT JOIN (SELECT channel, ROUND(SUM(paid_amount), 2) AS paid_sales FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-30' AND '2026-02-28' GROUP BY channel) AS o ON o.channel = m.channel ORDER BY ROI DESC

steps.question: 本月各渠道ROI：已支付销售额除以投放花费，两表各自按渠道汇总后计算，按ROI降序
